purpose: Seed-1 replication of the v9.0 varied-captions 100k convergence run. Declared after the flagship operating-point search: the v9.3-warmup flagship failed its pre-declared motion criterion at every milestone 40k-100k (centroid speed .21-.23 vs the required ~.28+ band; structure and binding passed), so per the declared fallback rule the release candidate is v9.0conv 100k. This run supersedes the flagship seed-1 arm (m6_protocol_v9p3_flagship_warmup_100k_s1, stopped at ~8k steps -- supersession recorded, nothing hidden) because seed replication of the ACTUAL release candidate and of the paper's rig-co-generation headline outranks a second seed of a recipe already judged non-flagship. Judgment: endpoint within seed noise of seed 0 (TVR .126 / speed .275 / TF divergence .2870) on the standing convergence evaluation.

frozen_model.backbone: full spatiotemporal DiT with signed local temporal and spatial 3D RoPE
frozen_model.teacher_forcing: clean ground-truth history during training; generated history during rollout

validation.claim_limit: Single-seed combined-treatment run; attribution of any gain to individual components rests on the matched 2k pilots, not on this run.

matched_control: the 40k caption-pair arms and the v8 100k pixel-only run
